messages:
alice: CI red on macOS-clang in the matrix — objc_bridge target failing with a missing generated header. Any ideas?
ci-bot: Build failed: macos-clang //apps/ios:objc_bridge. Full log: https://ci.redwood.com/12345/build/67890
dmitri: likely a genrule output/path change after the CMake -> Bazel wrapper tweak. Can you paste the failing compile lines? :eyes:
alice: here's the relevant excerpt from the log:
```
In file included from /workspace/apps/ios/objc_bridge.mm:10:
build/gen/objc/bridge/bridge.h:10:10: fatal error: 'bridge_generated.h' file not found
#include \"bridge_generated.h\"
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```
jen: hmm. We rolled the clang image in CI recently (clang-image:v2026.02 -> v2026.03). Could be runfiles/sandbox path changes.
sam: can we rerun just the macos-clang job? I can trigger: `ci rerun --matrix macos-clang --job objc_bridge`
alice: rerun started: https://ci.redwood.com/12345/build/67891 :thumbsup:
dmitri: if rerun still fails try `bazel build //apps/ios:objc_bridge --sandbox_debug --verbose_failures` inside the CI container and upload the tarball of the build tree. That usually shows where the generated header landed.
alice: rerun finished and failed with the same missing include. starting a bisect between commits abc123..def456 that touched the bazel/CMake wrapper.
dmitri: ping @jen — can we quickly revert the toolchain image tag in CI to confirm whether the image roll caused this? :shipit:
jen: opening rollback PR for the CI image tag now, will link it here once created. If rollback fixes things we can proceed with a careful bisect.
sam: FYI I'll mark objc_bridge_test flaky on linux so it doesn't block the matrix while we triage (moving it to flaky_beta).
ci-bot: Rerun completed: failure. See build 67891.
alice: thanks all. uploading verbose build logs and tarball to the bug ticket and moving to #incidents if it keeps failing. I added the bisect range and a note about the image roll.
